Entire objects visible, faithful texture. Sheer black-gray arch-striped wide-neck long-sleeve cropped top, opaque tonal lining at chest, dark brown low-rise fitted flared trousers with lace-up front, brown pointed shoes.。配饰：古铜圆环腰链；黑色细短颈圈；银色镂空宽手镯。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Edit this exact complete wardrobe board. Remove the gold ring chain worn across the trouser waist.
